title: Welcome to Alchemist
subtitle: Turn any topic into: Research, Synthesis, and a Decision PDF.
content: Alchemist is a deterministic execution engine. Let's walk through how to build your first research session.

title: Phase 1: Search & Build Nodes
subtitle: INPUT
content: Start by searching a topic. The engine will retrieve relevant knowledge nodes. You can lock nodes into your session to build the foundation of your research.

title: Phase 2: Synthesis
subtitle: PROCESS
content: Swipe through your locked cards. Alchemist automatically synthesizes the relationships between the concepts in real-time.

title: Phase 3: Export
subtitle: OUTPUT
content: When your research is complete, open the export panel to generate your Decision PDF or Knowledge Book. Your insights, formatted and ready.

title: Ready?
subtitle: Let's build your first decision engine.
content: The stack is ready. Your session begins now.
